newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline drops with crude's weakness.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline drops with crude's weakness.

text.p: NWE gasoline fell with crude while the backwardation to first half November narrowed with the month nearing an end, traders said.
Premium unleaded traded early at $230/$232 fob ARA and then fell to about $228/$230, down $7 from Wednesday, after Brent slipped toward its daily lows.
Speculation of French demand due to refinery turnarounds could not be confirmed by physical deals.
"It's because of the general weakness in the distillate and crude and now we're waiting for the States to see if it is a buy or sell," a trader said.
